overview_description.description: Growth Book is an open source feature flagging and A/B testing platform that helps companies make better data-driven product decisions. Our platform gives any company the power of a customized deployment and A/B testing solution like those used by AirBnB, Netflix, Uber, etc. without having to build it. Used in production by thousands of companies globally.

about_short_description.short_description: GrowthBook is an open source feature flagging and experimentation platform

product.name: Feature Flagging
product.description: A system to create, manage, and control feature flags for software deployment, enabling targeted releases and codebase management.

product.name: A/B Testing (Experimentation)
product.description: A platform to design, run, and analyze A/B tests using existing data sources for continuous product improvement.

product.name: Data Warehouse Native Integration
product.description: Integration with existing data warehouses and event tracking systems to use current data for feature flagging and experimentation.

product.name: Open Source Platform and Self-hosting
product.description: An open source platform for feature flagging and experimentation that can be self-hosted for full control and security.

product.name: Lightweight SDKs and APIs
product.description: Open source SDKs and APIs for multiple programming languages to integrate feature flags and experiments with applications.

identifier.value: Visual Editor for No-code Website Experimentation

product.name: Visual Editor for No-code Website Experimentation
product.description: A visual tool that allows users to run A/B tests and make website changes without coding or engineering support.
